test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A man deposits Rs. 8,000 at 10% rate of simple interest per annum. The total amount he will get at the end of 2 years is:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 8,000

Rate of Interest (R) = 10% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

Total Amount = Principal + Simple Interest

**Calculation:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (8000 × 10 × 2) / 100

⇒ SI = 1600

Total Amount = 8000 + 1600

⇒ Total Amount = 9600

**The total amount he will get at the end of 2 years is Rs. 9600.**
